blocks.text: 6271 272 STREET County Line Glen Valley Langley V4W 1P6

parts.t: Dreaming of your own hobby farm? This uniquely renovated manufactured home, sitting on 1.85 ACRES, offers just that! Discover a modern 2 bed/2 bath layout with abundant natural light streaming through large European-style windows and doors. Fully renovated in 2016, it boasts a new roof, kitchen, bathrooms, floors, newer septic field & tanks, and a brand-new Waterwell system. The kitchen dazzles with a Belfast sink, double oven, and spacious island. Relax in the master bedroom with its walk-in closet and luxurious ensuite, featuring a clawfoot tub. Enjoy panoramic views of the property from every room and the deck. Outbuildings include two barns, a shed, and a greenhouse. Plus, your very own pond!
